correctness.rationale: For a compact invariant μ of T(x,y)=(y,ax−x³−by), the coordinate marginals coincide; E[x³]=(a−b−1)m=ρ²m. On nonnegative support Cauchy–Schwarz gives (E[x²])²≤m E[x³]=ρ²m², whence 0≤m≤ρ and Var(x)=Var(y)≤m(ρ−m). Equality restricts positive coordinate values to ρ; the two off-diagonal points have images outside the equality carrier, leaving only δ(0,0),δ(ρ,ρ) mixtures. Odd symmetry handles the third quadrant; positive periodic orbit moment sum forces visits on both sides of ρ. Independently inspected the rational checker and algebra, not just VERIFY_OK. No claim for sign-spanning invariant measures or existence of strange attractors.
